answer: Because the sonnet release is recorded with every signature, the relic audit exposes the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, because each signer must be independent on the zephyr graph and each risks its bond. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 4 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. That is 28 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
